thread:
alice: Heads-up — PR #19023 needs to land before the scheduled maintenance (Sat 03:00 UTC). It's a small reconciliation fix that prevents a crash on malformed metadata. Unit tests green but ARM infra e2e is flaky. Requesting quick eyes and a safe canary plan to avoid the freeze risk.

ben: Can you drop the PR link and a one-line explainer?

alice: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/19023
One-liner: guard against nil metadata in async response path. Single-line change, adds a defensive check and a lightweight integration test.

carla: Security-related, so we should try to get it in pre-maintenance if it's low risk. What CI is failing?

alice: Failing job: e2e/arm-integration — intermittent socket timeout during a long-poll test. Locally I see it fail ~1/12 runs on arm32 emulator under network jitter.

ben: I can run on my ARM farm (qemu + Pis). If it's flaky we should run the failing test with --repeat=20 to be confident. Also suggest a 1% canary instead of 5% given it's an edge case.

carla: 1% sounds conservative but fine. We'll need a 45m monitoring window for p50/p95 and errors. If metrics look good, promote after 45m. Rollback trigger: error rate > 0.3% or p95 up by > 200ms.

alice: Proposed canary plan: route 1% traffic in us-east-1 for 45m, healthchecks every 60s, synthetic load generator hitting the metadata flow at 50rps. Rollout name: canary/19023-1pct-useast1.

deploy-bot: Canary playbook created: canary/19023-1pct-useast1 (owner: alice). Start with `/deploy canary canary/19023-1pct-useast1`.

ben: Starting local repeat run now: `./scripts/test-arm.sh --focus=metadata_guard --repeat=20` — will post results in ~30m.

ci-bot: CI update for PR #19023: e2e/arm-integration — FAILED (timeout at 00:14:33). Trace snippet: `ReadTimeoutError: socket.recv timed out during long_poll test`.

alice: That lines up. My patch adds a fast-path check but the test still hits a timing edge. I can add a small retry to the harness, but prefer to avoid changing tests just to pass CI unless necessary. Alternative: start canary with staging synthetic load before shifting real traffic.

carla: I'm fine approving if we get one successful clean CI run after a rebase + quiet rerun, or if ben's 20x local run is clean. We don't want to gamble going into the maintenance window without signals.

ben: Local run done: 20 repeats, 1 failure (timeout on run 13), same stack. I pushed a retry tweak that retries the long-poll once after 200ms jitter and kicked CI.

ci-bot: CI rerun for PR #19023: e2e/arm-integration — PASSED. All checks green. Duration: 00:19:02.

carla: Reviewed diff briefly. Defensive check + test looks tiny and readable. I'm approving. Please start the canary and attach the deploy link.

alice: Launching canary: `/deploy canary canary/19023-1pct-useast1`

deploy-bot: Canary started: https://deploys.redwood-inference.internal/canary/19023-1pct-useast1 — traffic=1%, target=svc-inference-v19023, synthetic load configured, healthchecks every 60s, monitor window=45m.

ben: I'll watch ARM telemetry and tail logs for the long-poll path. If I see >3 timeouts in 15m I'll call rollback.

alice: Thanks. If canary is steady for 45m we'll promote to 100% and mark as landed before the maintenance blackout. If we see continued ARM instability, we abort and plan to land in the rebase window after maintenance.

carla: Good coordination — thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :clap:
